protocol.accuracy_ties: Retain every exact accuracy tie; full-grid ranking uses summed correct counts of all three seeds.
protocol.ansatz: RealAmplitudes reverse_linear with final rotation layer, repetitions 1 or 2
protocol.bootstrap_method: Paired patient percentile bootstrap; same 91 selected patient indices for every width, configuration, seed and budget; model panels fixed; linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
protocol.cache_policy: At most one encoder bank per model, disk-backed for larger widths, chunked state evolution; one active configuration group per large width; release worker processes and prune cold disk banks to 4 GB after groups. Rebuild invariant banks when needed, never retrain completed fits.
protocol.completion: Authoritative verified per-fit atomic receipts first; coordinator alone writes Excel. Completion requires all activated fits, recomputed metrics and workbook readback agreement.
protocol.decision_rule: argmax of source-class columns [0,1], exact ties malignant 0; one final evaluation probability array per fit
protocol.evaluation_cap_semantics: SciPy maxiter/maxfun objective calls, verified actual nfev; genuine early termination allowed
protocol.feature_maps: ZFeatureMap without entanglement; ZZFeatureMap linear/full/circular, alpha=2, verified equivalent PauliFeatureMap paulis=[Z,ZZ]

full_grid_k04.justification: Additional optimization allowance and improved optimizer termination; no demonstrated meaningful accuracy gain.

protocol.incomplete_panels: No complete configuration mean or aggregate comparison unless every declared seed/fit is valid. Keep partial outcomes and failure rates.
protocol.initialization: Explicit default_rng(initialization_seed).uniform(0,1,n_parameters); identical across budgets within width/configuration/seed.
protocol.optional_300_rule: After both 48-fit stages finish: add all 48 at 300 if convergence fraction at 200 <0.90 OR upper descriptive 95% paired 200-100 accuracy interval >=+0.5 percentage points. Incomplete panels require review and all predeclared 300 fits, never silently drop failed seeds.
protocol.pilot_design: Balanced 16 configurations: feature map index=(p+r)%4. Not a full factorial grid.
protocol.planning_criteria_status: Practical study-design choices, not universal standards or guarantees of global optimization.
protocol.primary_metric: Validation accuracy, equally averaged over 16 configurations and three seed pairs.
protocol.readout: basis state integer %2, least-significant bit, NOT Hamming-weight parity
protocol.recommendation_rule: Among tested budgets with >=90% optimizer-reported convergence, smallest budget with mean validation accuracy within 0.5 percentage points of best tested mean. Otherwise none satisfies criterion. Recommendations are provisional; never launch larger-width grids.
protocol.recovery: Preserve interrupted attempt; restart original saved initialization and seeds with a new attempt ID; no warm starts.
protocol.resource_policy: Four-qubit up to three workers after live check. Each larger width begins with one compatible manifest fit; measure memory/throughput, compare two workers only if safe. Bound workers by RAM reserve, twice peak working set, cores and responsiveness; no forced CPU saturation.
protocol.sampler_rng: Fresh integer-seeded StatevectorSampler per fit; same common random uniforms per circuit, preserving installed reset semantics.
protocol.technical_retry: One automatic retry for OSError, MemoryError, TimeoutError or BrokenProcessPool. Keep poor and budget-limited fits; scientific failures require review.
protocol.test_access: Original test scores never determine budgets, scheduling, coverage or implementation. Phase A is exploratory fixed-split evidence with test-selection history. Pilots read only separate original-training source.
protocol.uncertainty_conditions: Conditional on this internal training split, these fitted models, the 16 configurations and three seed pairs; excludes retraining and pilot-selection uncertainty. Repeated predictions are not extra patients; no equivalence or formal multiple-comparison claims.
protocol.unresolved_rule: After 300, flag review if completion target unmet, any incomplete panel, or 300-200 upper interval >=0.5 points; continue to next width.
